parole.significato: The third letter of the Slovene alphabet, written in the Latin script.
parole.testo: From Gaj's Latin alphabet C, from Czech C, from Latin C, from Etruscan 𐌂 (c), from Ancient Greek Γ (G, Gamma), from Phoenician 𐤂 (g, giml). Pronunciation as IPA⁽ᵏᵉʸ⁾: /cə/ is initial Slovene (phoneme plus a fill vowel) and the second pronunciation is probably taken from German C.

parole.significato: The fifth letter of the Slovene alphabet, written in the Latin script.
parole.testo: From Gaj's Latin alphabet d, from Czech alphabet d, from Latin d, which is a modification of capital letter D, from Ancient Greek letter Δ (D, “Delta”). Pronunciation as IPA⁽ᵏᵉʸ⁾: /də/ is initial Slovene (phoneme plus a fill vowel) and the second pronunciation is probably taken from German d.

parole.significato: The sixth letter of the Slovene alphabet, written in the Latin script.
parole.testo: From Gaj's Latin alphabet e, from Czech alphabet e, from Latin e, which is a modification of capital letter E in uncial script, from Ancient Greek Ε (E, Epsilon).

parole.significato: The eighth letter of the Slovene alphabet, written in the Latin script.
parole.testo: From Gaj's Latin alphabet g, from Czech alphabet g, from Latin g. Pronunciation as /ɡə/ is initial Slovene (phoneme plus a fill vowel) and the second pronunciation is probably taken from German g.

parole.significato: password
parole.testo: Borrowed from Czech heslo, from Proto-Slavic *gъslo. If the word were to directly come from Proto-Slavic into Slovene, the result would be read as /'gəslo/.

parole.significato: The ninth letter of the Slovene alphabet, written in the Latin script.
parole.testo: From Gaj's Latin alphabet h, from Czech alphabet h, from Latin h. Pronunciation as /xə/ is initial Slovene (phoneme plus a fill vowel) and the second pronunciation is probably taken from German h.

parole.significato: The tenth letter of the Slovene alphabet, written in the Latin script.
parole.testo: From Gaj's Latin alphabet I, from Czech alphabet I, from Latin I, from the Etruscan letter 𐌉 (i, “i”), from the Ancient Greek letter Ι (I, iota), derived from the Phoenician letter 𐤉 (y, yod), from the Egyptian hieroglyph 𓂝.

parole.significato: The tenth letter of the Slovene alphabet, written in the Latin script.
parole.testo: From Gaj's Latin alphabet i, from Czech alphabet i, from Latin i, lower case variation of I from the Etruscan letter 𐌉 (i, “i”), from the Ancient Greek letter Ι (I, “iota”), derived from the Phoenician letter 𐤉 (y, “yod”), from the Egyptian hieroglyph 𓂝.

parole.significato: kangaroo
parole.testo: From Czech klokan.

parole.significato: beer
parole.testo: Borrowed from Czech pivo, from Proto-Slavic *pȋvo.

parole.significato: object (thing)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Czech předmět or Serbo-Croatian predmet, from Polish przedmiot.

parole.significato: robot
parole.testo: Borrowed from Czech robot, from robota (“drudgery, servitude”), from Old Czech robota, from Proto-Slavic *orbota, from *orbiti + *-ota.

parole.significato: government
parole.testo: From Czech vláda (a calque of German Regierung).

parole.significato: train (line of connected cars or carriages)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Czech vlak, itself calqued after German Zug.

parole.significato: hydrogen
parole.testo: From Czech vodík.
